address: 1106 S Miami Avenue, Suite 202, Miami, FL 33130
title: Empire Social Lounge — Brickell

images.caption: A dimly lit lounge area with leather armchairs and small round wooden tables.
Interior of a cigar shop with wooden shelves filled with cigar boxes, a sign reading 'Empire Social' on the back wall, and warm lighting from an ornate ceiling fixture.

A cozy café with two brown leather armchairs and a small round wooden table between them. A ceramic bowl and a menu are on the table. Behind the window, there is a wooden display shelf filled with assorted cigar boxes in a warm, ambient-lit setting.
A wooden hallway with many small, labeled compartments on both sides, and a vent and smoke in the ceiling.
Dimly lit bar with a dark wooden counter and shelves filled with various bottles of alcohol and glasses, and beige bar stools lined up in front.

selected_rooms.rationale: Enclosed indoor lounge with visible walls, doors, and ceiling; usable carpeted floor is clearly visible between the seating and tables.
Distinct enclosed display room with visible wood-paneled walls and ceiling, plus a clearly exposed tiled floor in the central aisle.
